snippet.title: Microsoft Edge | Play the Surf Game
snippet.description:
Wi-Fi acting gnarly? No worries!  When you can’t surf the web, you can surf the waves in the latest Microsoft Edge. Watch out for obstacles, grab power-ups, escape dangers from the depths, and hone your skills with time trials. Play any way you like—keyboard, mouse, touch screen, controller, or Xbox adaptive controller—just have fun!

Try it in the Microsoft Edge browser (even if you’re online) by typing edge://surf into the address bar. Surfs up!

Connect with us! 
Web: https://www.microsoftedge.com 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MicrosoftEdge 
Facebook: https://facebook.com/MicrosoftEdge
